messages:
maya: quick FYI I opened PR to unify 429/timeouts + streaming retry guidance across SDKs: https://git.redwood/infra/docs/pulls/5012
jordan: thanks. short ask: can PR include a one-paragraph migration note for customers on implicit sdk retries?
maya: yes. will state: migrate to explicit resume tokens or idempotency keys; disable implicit auto-retries for non-idempotent endpoints.
sam: i'll add compact snippets for node/python/ruby (<=8 lines). want them to use error.retry_after when present.
eli: QA: add a smoke test that simulates mid-stream 429 with Retry-After header and assert client waits then resumes using last-ack token. we should catch the previous regression.
maya: adding mocha/pytest smoke tests under docs/snippets/tests/stream-resume.
jordan: docs should warn about cost increase on aggressive retries and show circuit-breaker example. include header X-Idempotency-Key sample.
sam: pushed ruby snippet in branch. tiny example shows resume_token + backoff.
docs-bot: preview build up at https://docs.redwood.ai/preview/5012. please add changelog blurb in docs/CHANGELOG.md before merge.
maya: filed SDK issue #1009 to standardize error object with .retry_after and .retryable. linking in PR. will request reviews after tests pass. :rocket:
